desc: Feebas + Milotic event. Requires a rebuilt Pokemon Center (not the new Bubbly Basin one). Collect Prism Scales for swimming-themed furniture.

desc: Reminder only - tiers lost after close.

title: Blood Drive ends
desc: Donate blood for Event Tokens before they're forfeited.

title: Imaginarium Theater - monthly reset
desc: Confirmed in-game: resets monthly, NOT biweekly like Abyss (was wrongly assumed to share Abyss's schedule). Your usual pace: start ~3-4 days after reset.

title: Spiral Abyss - monthly reset
desc: Resets monthly on the 16th. Your usual pace: start ~3-4 days after reset.
